34:t_033:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't care what happens to me! I don't care what happens to the world!」

34:t_033:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I will save her, no matter what!!」

34:t_033:13.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Do it for what you want! Not for anyone else!!」

34:t_034:1.en:
$$マヤ$$
「It can't be...! The form-control limiter has disappeared! We can't analyze it!」

34:t_034:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「The EVA we kept within human limits is regaining its true form.」

34:t_034:3.en:
$$リツコ$$
「It's breaking the bonds humans placed on it, becoming something beyond humanity, close to a god.」

34:t_034:4.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Weaving heaven, earth, and all things together, it's condensing itself into pure energy in a vast surge of complementarity...」

34:t_034:5.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Simply to grant a human wish... For that alone...!」

34:t_035:0.en:
$n
「$$シンジ$$! If you go any further...!」

34:t_036:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「It's useless. Even if we try to stop this, we have no way to interfere with the EVA as it is now.」

34:t_037:0.en:
$$加持$$
「Using Unit-01 as the trigger before all the pieces are in place... Commander $$碇$$, $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$ won't stand for this.」

34:t_037:1.en:
$$冬月$$
「As expected, those two have brought about Unit-01's awakening.」

34:t_037:2.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Yes. We are almost at the realization of our plan.」

34:t_037:5.en:
$n
「If this keeps up...! If this keeps up!!」

34:t_037:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is he going to... become something other than human...!?」

34:t_038:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「...I see. You're awfully convenient, aren't you? Maybe it's because you smell different after all...」

34:t_039:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Ghh...! Is it too dangerous to stay here!?」

34:t_040:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ units are exploding!」

34:t_040:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Are we going to be all right!?」

34:t_040:2.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「I don't know! None of our sensors can make sense of the situation!」

34:t_040:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But this feeling...! I've felt something like it before!」

34:t_040:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「This is... It can't be...!」

34:t_040:5.en:
$$リツコ$$
「A new life is being born, beyond this world's natural order. In exchange, the old life will perish.」

34:t_040:7.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Yes, the continuation of $$セカンドインパクト$$... $$サードインパクト$$ is beginning. The world is ending...」

34:t_042:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$碇シンジ$$... This time, I'll make sure you, at least, find happiness.」

34:t_043:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Tch...! Is this as far as I can go in this ship!?」

34:t_043:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$c...! Don't think this is the full extent of my power!」

34:t_044:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「I don't think... that was just a sore loser's excuse.」

34:t_044:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Why did $$サイデリアル$$ force its way through to get here...?」

34:t_045:0.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 has one minute left until its operating limit!」

34:t_045:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「We'll save $$綾波$$ in this last minute!」

34:t_047:0.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 has reached its operating limit!」

34:t_047:1.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Is this... as far as we can go...!?」

34:t_047:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Move... Move... Move! Come on, move!」

34:t_047:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you don't move, $$綾波$$ will...!!」

34:t_048:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I confirm all $$新地球皇国$$ forces have been destroyed!」

34:t_048:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Now all we have to do is rescue $$レイ#pt394$$!」

34:t_048:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, hurry! Concentrate your attacks on the Angel!」

34:t_101:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「I drop by HQ for once, and it's crawling with enemies. It really is a cruel world...!」

34:t_101:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... that's our fate...! Mine and the EVA's!」

34:t_102:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'm sorry, $$綾波$$... If only I'd come sooner...)

34:t_102:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I won't hesitate anymore...! Fighting in the EVA is my fight...!)

34:t_102:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'll save you, $$綾波$$! So... so just wait a little longer!)

34:t_103:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Can you hear me, $$レイ#pt394$$!? It's me! $$早乙女アルト$$!」

34:t_103:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stay strong! You haven't let $$シンジ$$ try your miso soup yet, have you!?」

34:t_103:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$シンジ$$ will be there soon! Hold on until he gets there!!」

34:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hang on, $$レイ#pt394$$! I'll tear this monster off you!」

34:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just hold on a little longer! $$シンジ$$ is coming for you!」

34:t_105:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, I cannot detect the rescue target's vital signs anywhere within the attack target.」

34:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't give a damn about that...!」

uncertain: 34:t_038:0: Mari addresses the awakened EVA as a conveniently obliging creature; its different smell is preserved without specifying what she compares it to.
notes: Misato urges Shinji to pursue his own wish. Complementarity is retained as Ritsuko's scientific wording. Branch battle lines follow the awakening scene but remain in source order.
